card.name: Space before a number in dosing tables
card.fires_on: The space (or first digit) just before a number in a range such as '1 to 2 (0.16 to 0.32)', and the space after a numbered instruction step. Seen in nutrition dosing tables and step-by-step preparation directions.

modes.label: Number ranges
modes.description: The blank or digit right before the second number in a 'X to Y' dosing range.

modes.label: Between numbered steps
modes.description: The space after a step ends and before the next step number.
